up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5303304. Return each molecule's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name). Link the document to molecules via compound_records (docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id, then compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno). Ensure each distinct molecule is listed only once. Do not apply any additional filters (no restrictions on molecule type, activity data, or confidence scores).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5303304';
